Date: 2027-04-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Portal onboarding request: evidence needed for AcmeHealth

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for agreeing to onboard AcmeHealth to ClearData's security portal. To speed up their profile activation we need the following items uploaded to the portal or attached to this thread:

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- KMS / key rotation policy and any HSM/KMS attestations
- A short network diagram or architectural summary showing where Redwood's inference endpoints reside (public cloud region + VPC outline is fine)

AcmeHealth's security team is expecting the evidence by EOD PT on 4/13. If you prefer, we can provision temporary S3 upload credentials tied to their portal account. Portal invite link will be included once we confirm a primary contact.

Primary contact we've got is: rafael.mendes@redwood.com (assignable). Please also indicate whether you'll provide a service-account-level read-only credential for automated evidence ingestion.

Thanks,
Olivia
Security Onboarding Manager
ClearData

Thanks — attaching our KMS rotation policy and a quick network sketch (.png). A few practical notes for ClearData portal ingestion:

- We can create a limited service account with read-only access to a dedicated S3 bucket. That bucket will have objects encrypted with a customer-managed CMK in our KMS; we can provide role-based temporary presigns for upload if portal supports it.
- Rotation cadence: quarterly key rotation, with emergency rotation playbook documented in the attached KMS policy.
- Architecture sketch: inference endpoints sit in a private subnet; egress goes through a NAT GW; metrics and traces are pushed to a separate telemetry VPC.

Kimberly Park
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks — received, and this is perfect. I've provisioned the AcmeHealth portal profile and sent an invite to rafael.mendes@redwood.com. The portal supports both direct uploads and S3 presigned ingestion; for automation, the read-only service account scope you proposed is sufficient (we only require list/get on the upload prefix).

I've attached the portal invite (HTML stub) and also uploaded the SOC2 and KMS policy to the profile on our side. Acme's security team (security@acmehealth.com) has been notified and will comment in the portal if they need addenda or clarifications.

Next steps for Redwood:
- Rafael: accept the invite and confirm which upload method you will use (portal UI vs S3 presign + service account).
- Ben/Kimberly: if Acme requests an SOC addendum for on-prem connectors, we'll queue that with your team; they'll likely request a short attestation about connector scope.

I'll keep this thread in case anything else is needed.

Best,
Olivia
